name: Jeet Poptani
headline: ERP & Business AI Transformation | Global SAP S/4 HANA, D365, IFS & AI Programmes Delivery | Value Creation for C-Suite & Investors| Enterprise Architect & TOM Design | PE Venture, M&A IT Carve-Out, Strategic Turnaround
about:
I lead complex ERP and business transformations at scale. Advise the C-suite leadership team to leverage AI to improve efficiency and drive revenue growth. 

Over the past 20 years, I've led 40+ SAP ECC, S/4HANA, D365, SuccessFactors, multi-ERP, and AI-driven transformation programmes across 25 countries and 18 industries. 

I move fast in ambiguous environments, adapt as the business evolves, and deliver value.

From a £500m SAP rollout at Jaguar Land Rover that unlocked 700% manufacturing growth, to a £14m HANA migration at Diageo spanning 180 countries, to a £16m S/4HANA delivery at Adevinta completed 100% on time across 13 European countries — I've consistently delivered where the stakes are high. 

I operate at the CEO and CxO levels to define the transformation strategy, build the roadmap, and ensure its delivery. I bridge the gap between boardroom ambition and ground-level delivery — working across the full ERP application stack, including SAP S/4HANA, D365, Successfactor, Ariba, and enterprise AI.

Holding an MBA from London Business School, I bring a sharp commercial lens to every engagement — understanding the financial levers, M&A dynamics, and PE value creation priorities that drive transformation decisions at the board level. My current focus is helping organisations navigate the intersection of SAP modernisation and AI adoption — building practical AI strategies that strengthen the P&L, not cut costs.

What I bring:
— Complex programme recovery and delivery in tight timelines
— Full ERP stack leadership: SAP S/4HANA, D365, Successfactor, Ariba, AI integration
— CEO/CIO advisory: strategy design through to execution
— Finance, M&A and Private Equity: transaction support, IT carve-outs and TSA exits ($9.2B+ transactions)
— Multi-vendor programme management (SAP, TCS, Accenture, Deloitte, IBM)

Open to SAP Programme Director, IT Transformation Director, and C-Suite AI Advisory engagements across Europe and globally.
… more

experiences.position: AI Strategy & Adoption | SAP S/4 HANA & AI Programme Director | Governance & Compliance
experiences.description:
I specialise in helping organisations adopt AI, automation and data-driven operating models by translating complex technology into practical business value.

Act as a strategic advisor for AI technology and enterprise profitability, helping organisations identify high-impact use cases, re-engineer core business processes, and scale Agentic and generative AI across the organisation to improve efficiency, strengthen the P&L, and build sustainable competitive advantage.

Advisor to the C-suite on AI strategy, policy, governance, and ethical risk frameworks — aligning innovation with global regulatory frameworks including the EU AI Act, US Executive Order on AI, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and OECD AI Principles. Oversee vendor compliance, model lifecycle governance, and data traceability to maintain integrity, security, and transparency in AI systems.
